valuation.method: Forward EPS x P/E (FY2027E diluted EPS viewed at the 12-month target date)

bear.driver: Industrial MRO demand slowdown and operating margin compression below 15.5%

base.driver: Steady High-Touch Solutions and Endless Assortment growth with ~16.1% operating margin

bull.driver: Sustained double-digit organic sales growth and digital fulfillment operating leverage

valuation.implied_by_close: At base FY2027E EPS of $51.00, the $1,489.30 close implies 29.2x P/E; the post-Q3 named analyst targets ($1,380-$1,645) imply 27.1x-32.3x on base EPS.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $51.00 (3.4 pp).
valuation.watch_metric: Daily organic constant-currency sales growth and adjusted operating margin (16.0%-16.2% FY2026 guidance)
valuation.next_disclosure: Q4 2026 earnings release on February 2, 2027 (7:00 AM CT)

analyst_notes: Following Grainger's Q3 2026 beat and FY2026 guidance raise on November 4, 2026, Oppenheimer ($1,645), RBC Capital ($1,582), Jefferies ($1,500), and Stephens ($1,380) all raised their price targets. While Oppenheimer maintains Outperform, most tracked brokers remain at Hold/Equal-Weight/Sector Perform because the $1,489.30 close already prices in ~29.2x FY2027E EPS, leaving limited upside to our $1,453.50 base case. Note that Morgan Stanley ($1,590 on Nov 16), Barclays ($1,355 on Nov 16), and Baird's downgrade ($1,500 on Nov 20) occurred after the 2026-11-13 cutoff and are excluded.
